root_cause: The exclusive checkbox for 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' contains an erroneous empty style attribute that interferes with the NHSUK checkboxes widget's exclusive logic, preventing it from clearing other checkboxes in the group when selected.
repair_strategy: Remove the extraneous empty style attribute from the exclusive checkbox input while preserving the data-checkbox-exclusive and data-checkbox-exclusive-group attributes.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms" style="">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">

expected_accessibility_effect: Restores keyboard-accessible mutually exclusive behavior for the symptom group, ensuring that selecting 'No symptoms' clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard and 4.1.2 name/role/value requirements.
functional_risks: Removal of an empty style attribute has no visual impact; no known functional side effects.
verification_requirements: After the edit, journey step 5 must pass: focusing #symptoms-none and pressing Space results in form-data symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being empty.
Ensure that selecting a symptom after choosing 'No symptoms' clears the exclusive option (optional but recommended).
Regression guard for the contact group must continue to pass.
